# Thin content on Torrente product pages

Crawl word count on the 12 Torrente trail running product pages: median 48 words of unique copy in Italian and 41 in English, the rest is boilerplate. Trailforge averages 380. Thin content correlates with the poor rankings of the line and with the lowest add-to-cart rate in the catalogue. The 120-word minimum decided for product pages applies first to this line; a copy refresh brief exists.
